description: This file defines a Drupal Views field plugin class 'Node' that provides functionality to render a link to a node within a view, including options to enable/disable linking and handle language variations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A Drupal Views field plugin class that renders a link to a node, with configurable options for linking and language handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the field plugin, adding the node ID field to additional fields if linking is enabled.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the field, including whether to link to the node.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the field, allowing users to enable or disable linking to the node.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Prepares and returns a link to the node, considering language and link options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the field value, applying link rendering if enabled.
